## Checklist

- [ ] Commits follow Conventional Commits (`feat:`, `fix:`, …). The changelog is built from them.
- [ ] Anything that touches deleting keeps the ground rules in [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/theescodes/unsay/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md),
      and their tests still pass.
- [ ] No new origins or permissions, or the README permission table and the store justification
      are updated in this pull request.
- [ ] Tests use the fake claude.ai, never the real one.
- [ ] UI changes are checked in light and dark mode.
